zones.name: The Dayside
zones.description: Superheated desert of molten glass and limitless solar energy. Domain of the Array.

zones.name: The Terminator Zone
zones.description: The narrow band of twilight where humanity survives. Cities, Greenways, and Lighthouses.

zones.name: The Nightside
zones.description: Permanent darkness and lethal cold. Bioluminescent predators and ancient ruins.

locations.name: Solar Fields
locations.description: Vast harvester arrays managed by the Array. Source of energy and silicon.

locations.name: Meridian City
locations.description: Capital of the Terminator Zone. Seat of the Meridian Council.

locations.name: Homestead
locations.description: A frontier settlement on the edge of the habitable zone.

locations.name: Outpost Balor
locations.description: Frontier Lightkeeper outpost. Your base of operations on the border.

locations.name: The Perimeter
locations.description: Fortified border between the habitable zone and the Nightside.

locations.name: Station Junction
locations.description: Transit hub connecting the frontier to Meridian City.

locations.name: Lighthouse Mara
locations.description: The nearest fallen Lighthouse. First expedition into the true Nightside.

locations.name: Old Watchtower
locations.description: Crumbling pre-war observation post. Something stirs in the ruins.

locations.name: Frost Crypts
locations.description: Frozen caverns deep in the dark. Ice formations and creatures that camouflage as frost.

locations.name: Signal Cave
locations.description: A cave emitting strange signals. Source unknown.

locations.name: The Dead Road
locations.description: Ancient trade route into the deep Nightside. Long abandoned.

locations.name: Fen Cache
locations.description: Hidden supply cache in the wetlands. Unbounded territory.

locations.name: Deep Perimeter
locations.description: The furthest reach of Lightkeeper patrols. Beyond here, nothing is charted.

locations.name: Underlumen Approach
locations.description: Pre-human ruins pulsing with an eerie glow. The Underlumen stirs.
